newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain gvt authorises invest trusts to buy in OTCs.
newsitem.headline: Spain gvt authorises invest trusts to buy in OTCs.

text.p: Spain's cabinet on Friday approved a draft law that will allow investment trusts to invest part of their portfolio in assets which are not listed on organised financial markets, a government spokesman said.

"(The government approved) a real decree that will allow private savings to be channelled through investment trusts in non-listed assets," government spokesman Miguel Angel Rodriguez told a news conference after the cabinet's weekly meeting.
He added that the main aim of the new measure was to offer small and medium firms alternative financing sources.
But, under the law, investment trusts will only be allowed to invest 10 percent of their portfolio in such assets.
The limit will be reduced to five percent for trusts investing in money market assets.
The law must now pass through Congress.
